    "content": "use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

pub struct GatePacg {
    store: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, (String, u64)>>>,
    capacity: usize,
}

impl GatePacg {
    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {
        GatePacg {
            store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::with_capacity(capacity))),
            capacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        store.get(key).map(|(v, _)| v.clone())
    }

    pub fn put(&self, key: String, value: String) {
        let mut store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        if store.len() >= self.capacity && !store.contains_key(&key) {
            if let Some(oldest) = store.keys().next().cloned() {
                store.remove(&oldest);
            }
        }
        let ts = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap()
            .as_secs();
        store.insert(key, (value, ts));
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.store.lock().unwrap().len()
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.len() == 0
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_basic_ops() {
        let cache = GatePacg::new(10);
        cache.put("key1".into(), "val1".into());

        assert_eq!(cache.get("missing"), None);

        cache.put("a".into(), "1".into());
        cache.put("b".into(), "2".into());
        cache.put("c".into(), "3".into());
        assert!(cache.len() <= 2);
    }
}

import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;

public class PipeTotl {
    private final Map<String, Object> store;
    private final int capacity;
    private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();

    public PipeTotl(int capacity) {
        this.capacity = capacity;
        this.store = new LinkedHashMap<>(capacity, 0.75f, true) {
            @Override
            protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<String, Object> eldest) {
                return size() > PipeTotl.this.capacity;
            }
        };
    }

    public Object get(String key) {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return store.get(key);
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public void put(String key, Object value) {
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            store.put(key, value);
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public int size() {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return store.size();
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        PipeTotl c = new PipeTotl(10);
        c.put("test", "value");
        System.out.println("Size: " + c.size());
        System.out.println("Get: " + c.get("test"));
    }
}

    "content": "interface INodeYxxpOptions {
  capacity: number;
  ttlMs: number;
}

interface INodeYxxpEntry<T> {
  value: T;
  expiresAt: number;
  accessCount: number;
}

export class NodeYxxp<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, INodeYxxpEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<INodeYxxpOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 103;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 19662;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;

import (

type StackTbpn struct {
	mu       sync.RWMutex
	store    map[string]entry
	capacity int
}

type entry struct {
	value     interface{}
	timestamp time.Time
}

func NewStackTbpn(capacity int) *StackTbpn {
	return &StackTbpn{
		store:    make(map[string]entry, capacity),
		capacity: capacity,
	}
}

func (c *StackTbpn) Get(key string) (interface{}, bool) {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	e, ok := c.store[key]
	if !ok {
		return nil, false
	}
	return e.value, true
}

func (c *StackTbpn) Put(key string, value interface{}) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if len(c.store) >= c.capacity {
		var oldest string
		var oldestTime time.Time
		for k, v := range c.store {
			if oldest == "" || v.timestamp.Before(oldestTime) {
				oldest = k
				oldestTime = v.timestamp
			}
		}
		delete(c.store, oldest)
	}
	c.store[key] = entry{value: value, timestamp: time.Now()}
}

func (c *StackTbpn) Len() int {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	return len(c.store)

  capacity: number;
  ttlMs: number;
}

interface ILambdaRgdxEntry<T> {
  value: T;
  expiresAt: number;
  accessCount: number;
}

export class LambdaRgdx<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, ILambdaRgdxEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<ILambdaRgdxOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 1249;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 82924;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            store.put(key, value);
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return store.size();
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }

use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

pub struct AlphaNrvi {
    store: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, (String, u64)>>>,
    capacity: usize,
}

impl AlphaNrvi {
    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {
        AlphaNrvi {
            store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::with_capacity(capacity))),
            capacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        store.get(key).map(|(v, _)| v.clone())
    }

    pub fn put(&self, key: String, value: String) {
        let mut store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        if store.len() >= self.capacity && !store.contains_key(&key) {
            if let Some(oldest) = store.keys().next().cloned() {
                store.remove(&oldest);
            }
        }
        let ts = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap()
            .as_secs();
        store.insert(key, (value, ts));
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.store.lock().unwrap().len()
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.len() == 0
    }
}

export class MeshPsnv<T = unknown> {

  constructor(options: Partial<IMeshPsnvOptions> = {}) {

  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {

  capacity: number;
  ttlMs: number;
}

interface IZetaPvgsEntry<T> {
  value: T;
  expiresAt: number;
  accessCount: number;
}

export class ZetaPvgs<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, IZetaPvgsEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<IZetaPvgsOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 1805;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 94687;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

from typing import List, Tuple, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass(order=True)
class NodeBqakItem:
    priority: float
    sequence: int = field(compare=True)
    key: str = field(compare=False)
    value: object = field(compare=False, repr=False)

class NodeBqak:
    """Priority queue with O(log n) insert/extract and O(1) peek."""
    def __init__(self, max_size: int = 6034):
        self.max_size = max_size
        self._heap: List[NodeBqakItem] = []
        self._counter = 0
        self._entry_map = {}

    def push(self, key: str, value: object, priority: float = 0.0) -> bool:
        if len(self._heap) >= self.max_size and key not in self._entry_map:
            return False
        if key in self._entry_map:
            self.remove(key)
        item = NodeBqakItem(priority=priority, sequence=self._counter, key=key, value=value)
        self._counter += 1
        heapq.heappush(self._heap, item)
        self._entry_map[key] = item
        return True

    def pop(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object]]:
        while self._heap:
            item = heapq.heappop(self._heap)
            if item.key in self._entry_map:
                del self._entry_map[item.key]
                return (item.key, item.value)
        return None

    def peek(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object, float]]:
        while self._heap:
            if self._heap[0].key in self._entry_map:
                item = self._heap[0]
                return (item.key, item.value, item.priority)
            heapq.heappop(self._heap)
        return None

    def remove(self, key: str) -> bool:
        if key in self._entry_map:
            del self._entry_map[key]
            return True
        return False

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._entry_map)

    def __contains__(self, key: str) -> bool:
        return key in self._entry_map

class ThetaPtyf {
public:
    explicit ThetaPtyf(size_t capacity) : capacity_(capacity) {}

    std::optional<std::string> get(const std::string& key) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        auto it = map_.find(key);
        if (it == map_.end()) return std::nullopt;
        items_.splice(items_.begin(), items_, it->second);
        return it->second->second;
    }

    void put(const std::string& key, const std::string& value) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        auto it = map_.find(key);
        if (it != map_.end()) {
            items_.splice(items_.begin(), items_, it->second);
            it->second->second = value;
            return;
        }
        if (items_.size() >= capacity_) {
            auto& back = items_.back();
            map_.erase(back.first);
            items_.pop_back();
        }
        items_.emplace_front(key, value);
        map_[key] = items_.begin();
    }

    size_t size() const {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        return items_.size();
    }

private:
    size_t capacity_;
    std::list<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> items_;
    std::unordered_map<std::string, decltype(items_)::iterator> map_;

	store    map[string]entry
	capacity int

	value     interface{}
	timestamp time.Time

func NewKappaCbli(capacity int) *KappaCbli {

		store:    make(map[string]entry, capacity),
		capacity: capacity,

	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()

	}

}

func (c *KappaCbli) Put(key string, value interface{}) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if len(c.store) >= c.capacity {
		var oldest string
		var oldestTime time.Time

				oldestTime = v.timestamp
			}
		}
		delete(c.store, oldest)
	}
	c.store[key] = entry{value: value, timestamp: time.Now()}
}

	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	return len(c.store)

from typing import List, Tuple, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass(order=True)
class SyncNlhzItem:
    priority: float
    sequence: int = field(compare=True)
    key: str = field(compare=False)
    value: object = field(compare=False, repr=False)

class SyncNlhz:
    """Priority queue with O(log n) insert/extract and O(1) peek."""
    def __init__(self, max_size: int = 1594):
        self.max_size = max_size
        self._heap: List[SyncNlhzItem] = []
        self._counter = 0
        self._entry_map = {}

    def push(self, key: str, value: object, priority: float = 0.0) -> bool:
        if len(self._heap) >= self.max_size and key not in self._entry_map:
            return False
        if key in self._entry_map:
            self.remove(key)
        item = SyncNlhzItem(priority=priority, sequence=self._counter, key=key, value=value)
        self._counter += 1
        heapq.heappush(self._heap, item)
        self._entry_map[key] = item
        return True

    def pop(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object]]:
        while self._heap:
            item = heapq.heappop(self._heap)
            if item.key in self._entry_map:
                del self._entry_map[item.key]
                return (item.key, item.value)
        return None

    def peek(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object, float]]:
        while self._heap:
            if self._heap[0].key in self._entry_map:
                item = self._heap[0]
                return (item.key, item.value, item.priority)
            heapq.heappop(self._heap)
        return None

    def remove(self, key: str) -> bool:
        if key in self._entry_map:
            del self._entry_map[key]
            return True
        return False

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._entry_map)

    def __contains__(self, key: str) -> bool:
        return key in self._entry_map

    this.#ttlMs = ttlMs;

    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.#store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }

    if (this.#store.has(key)) this.#store.delete(key);
    if (this.#store.size >= this.#capacity) {

      this.#store.delete(firstKey);
    }
    this.#store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.#ttlMs),
    });
  }

  delete(key) {
    return this.#store.delete(key);
  }

  get size() {

pub struct ApexMpgq {
    store: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, (String, u64)>>>,
    capacity: usize,
}

impl ApexMpgq {
    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {
        ApexMpgq {
            store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::with_capacity(capacity))),
            capacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        store.get(key).map(|(v, _)| v.clone())
    }

    pub fn put(&self, key: String, value: String) {
        let mut store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        if store.len() >= self.capacity && !store.contains_key(&key) {
            if let Some(oldest) = store.keys().next().cloned() {
                store.remove(&oldest);
            }
        }
        let ts = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap()
            .as_secs();
        store.insert(key, (value, ts));
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.store.lock().unwrap().len()
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.len() == 0

from typing import Callable, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

class TaskState(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()
    FAILED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

@dataclass
class TaskResult:
    task_id: str
    state: TaskState
    result: Any = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0

class RingFegt:
    """Async task scheduler with retry, timeout, and concurrency control."""
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 44, max_retries: int = 1):
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 54.7, **kwargs) -> str:
        self._counter += 1
        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result.state = TaskState.FAILED

    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResult]:
        return self._tasks.get(task_id)

    @property
    def active_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for t in self._tasks.values() if t.state == TaskState.RUNNING)

from typing import Callable, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

class TaskState(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()
    FAILED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

@dataclass
class TaskResult:
    task_id: str
    state: TaskState
    result: Any = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0

class SyncPagd:
    """Async task scheduler with retry, timeout, and concurrency control."""
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 34, max_retries: int = 4):
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 47.8, **kwargs) -> str:
        self._counter += 1
        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result.state = TaskState.FAILED

    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResult]:
        return self._tasks.get(task_id)

    @property
    def active_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for t in self._tasks.values() if t.state == TaskState.RUNNING)

from collections import OrderedDict
from typing import Any, Optional

class SyncQazw:
    """Thread-safe data structure with configurable capacity and TTL."""
    def __init__(self, capacity: int = 718, ttl: float = 41.3):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._store: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._hits = 0
        self._misses = 0

    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[Any]:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key not in self._store:
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            value, timestamp = self._store[key]
            if time.time() - timestamp > self.ttl:
                del self._store[key]
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._hits += 1
            return value

    def put(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._store[key] = (value, time.time())
            while len(self._store) > self.capacity:
                self._store.popitem(last=False)

    def delete(self, key: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                del self._store[key]
                return True
            return False

    @property
    def hit_rate(self) -> float:
        total = self._hits + self._misses
        return self._hits / total if total > 0 else 0.0

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._store)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._store.clear()
            self._hits = 0
            self._misses = 0

use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

pub struct KappaKsii {
    store: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, (String, u64)>>>,
    capacity: usize,
}

impl KappaKsii {
    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {
        KappaKsii {
            store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::with_capacity(capacity))),
            capacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        store.get(key).map(|(v, _)| v.clone())
    }

    pub fn put(&self, key: String, value: String) {
        let mut store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        if store.len() >= self.capacity && !store.contains_key(&key) {
            if let Some(oldest) = store.keys().next().cloned() {
                store.remove(&oldest);
            }
        }
        let ts = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap()
            .as_secs();
        store.insert(key, (value, ts));
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.store.lock().unwrap().len()
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.len() == 0
    }

	store    map[string]entry
	capacity int

	value     interface{}
	timestamp time.Time
}

func NewFluxRfcv(capacity int) *FluxRfcv {

		store:    make(map[string]entry, capacity),
		capacity: capacity,
	}

func (c *FluxRfcv) Get(key string) (interface{}, bool) {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	e, ok := c.store[key]
	if !ok {
		return nil, false
	}
	return e.value, true
}

func (c *FluxRfcv) Put(key string, value interface{}) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if len(c.store) >= c.capacity {

				oldestTime = v.timestamp
			}

		delete(c.store, oldest)
	}
	c.store[key] = entry{value: value, timestamp: time.Now()}
}

	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	return len(c.store)

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        auto it = map_.find(key);
        if (it == map_.end()) return std::nullopt;
        items_.splice(items_.begin(), items_, it->second);

            map_.erase(back.first);

  capacity: number;
  ttlMs: number;
}

interface IRingRmlhEntry<T> {
  value: T;
  expiresAt: number;
  accessCount: number;
}

export class RingRmlh<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, IRingRmlhEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<IRingRmlhOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 1113;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 19918;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

from collections import OrderedDict
from typing import Any, Optional

class GateHkze:
    """Thread-safe data structure with configurable capacity and TTL."""
    def __init__(self, capacity: int = 487, ttl: float = 251.3):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._store: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._hits = 0
        self._misses = 0

    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[Any]:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key not in self._store:
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            value, timestamp = self._store[key]
            if time.time() - timestamp > self.ttl:
                del self._store[key]
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._hits += 1
            return value

    def put(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._store[key] = (value, time.time())
            while len(self._store) > self.capacity:
                self._store.popitem(last=False)

    def delete(self, key: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                del self._store[key]
                return True
            return False

    @property
    def hit_rate(self) -> float:
        total = self._hits + self._misses
        return self._hits / total if total > 0 else 0.0

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._store)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._store.clear()
            self._hits = 0
            self._misses = 0

    "content": "interface ICacheQidsOptions {
  capacity: number;
  ttlMs: number;
}

interface ICacheQidsEntry<T> {
  value: T;
  expiresAt: number;
  accessCount: number;
}

export class CacheQids<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, ICacheQidsEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<ICacheQidsOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 1467;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 73995;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

from typing import Callable, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

class TaskState(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()
    FAILED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

@dataclass
class TaskResult:
    task_id: str
    state: TaskState
    result: Any = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0

class MeshEhun:
    """Async task scheduler with retry, timeout, and concurrency control."""
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 6, max_retries: int = 3):
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 53.2, **kwargs) -> str:
        self._counter += 1
        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result.state = TaskState.FAILED

    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResult]:
        return self._tasks.get(task_id)

    @property
    def active_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for t in self._tasks.values() if t.state == TaskState.RUNNING)

from typing import Callable, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

class TaskState(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()
    FAILED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

@dataclass
class TaskResult:
    task_id: str
    state: TaskState
    result: Any = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0

class GateGdgq:
    """Async task scheduler with retry, timeout, and concurrency control."""
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 42, max_retries: int = 5):
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 5.9, **kwargs) -> str:
        self._counter += 1
        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result.state = TaskState.FAILED

    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResult]:
        return self._tasks.get(task_id)

    @property
    def active_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for t in self._tasks.values() if t.state == TaskState.RUNNING)

public class CacheItqu {
    private final Map<String, Object> store;
    private final int capacity;
    private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();

    public CacheItqu(int capacity) {
        this.capacity = capacity;
        this.store = new LinkedHashMap<>(capacity, 0.75f, true) {
            @Override
            protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<String, Object> eldest) {
                return size() > CacheItqu.this.capacity;
            }
        };
    }

    public Object get(String key) {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return store.get(key);
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public void put(String key, Object value) {
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            store.put(key, value);
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public int size() {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return store.size();
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        CacheItqu c = new CacheItqu(10);
        c.put("test", "value");
        System.out.println("Size: " + c.size());

use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

pub struct RingGtej {
    store: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, (String, u64)>>>,
    capacity: usize,
}

impl RingGtej {
    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {
        RingGtej {
            store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::with_capacity(capacity))),
            capacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        store.get(key).map(|(v, _)| v.clone())
    }

    pub fn put(&self, key: String, value: String) {
        let mut store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        if store.len() >= self.capacity && !store.contains_key(&key) {
            if let Some(oldest) = store.keys().next().cloned() {
                store.remove(&oldest);
            }
        }
        let ts = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap()
            .as_secs();
        store.insert(key, (value, ts));
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.store.lock().unwrap().len()
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.len() == 0
    }

    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;

  }

pub struct StackEszv {
    store: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, (String, u64)>>>,
    capacity: usize,
}

impl StackEszv {
    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {
        StackEszv {
            store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::with_capacity(capacity))),
            capacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        store.get(key).map(|(v, _)| v.clone())
    }

    pub fn put(&self, key: String, value: String) {
        let mut store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        if store.len() >= self.capacity && !store.contains_key(&key) {
            if let Some(oldest) = store.keys().next().cloned() {
                store.remove(&oldest);
            }
        }
        let ts = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap()
            .as_secs();
        store.insert(key, (value, ts));
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.store.lock().unwrap().len()
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.len() == 0
    }

            value, timestamp = self._store[key]
            if time.time() - timestamp > self.ttl:

                self._misses += 1
                return None
            self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._hits += 1

        with self._lock:

        auto it = map_.find(key);

  capacity: number;
  ttlMs: number;

interface IVaultMfpiEntry<T> {
  value: T;
  expiresAt: number;
  accessCount: number;
}

export class VaultMfpi<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, IVaultMfpiEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<IVaultMfpiOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 717;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 101233;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

    private final int capacity;
    private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();

        this.capacity = capacity;
        this.store = new LinkedHashMap<>(capacity, 0.75f, true) {

from typing import Callable, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

class TaskState(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()
    FAILED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

@dataclass
class TaskResult:
    task_id: str
    state: TaskState
    result: Any = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0

class StreamNdxd:
    """Async task scheduler with retry, timeout, and concurrency control."""
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 43, max_retries: int = 3):
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 37.7, **kwargs) -> str:
        self._counter += 1
        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result.state = TaskState.FAILED

    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResult]:
        return self._tasks.get(task_id)

    @property
    def active_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for t in self._tasks.values() if t.state == TaskState.RUNNING)

    "content": "interface ICacheKuxwOptions {
  capacity: number;
  ttlMs: number;
}

interface ICacheKuxwEntry<T> {
  value: T;
  expiresAt: number;
  accessCount: number;
}

export class CacheKuxw<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, ICacheKuxwEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<ICacheKuxwOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 1553;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 13163;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;

public class HeapDrjz {
    private final Map<String, Object> store;
    private final int capacity;
    private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();

    public HeapDrjz(int capacity) {
        this.capacity = capacity;
        this.store = new LinkedHashMap<>(capacity, 0.75f, true) {
            @Override
            protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<String, Object> eldest) {
                return size() > HeapDrjz.this.capacity;
            }
        };
    }

    public Object get(String key) {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return store.get(key);
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public void put(String key, Object value) {
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            store.put(key, value);
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public int size() {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return store.size();
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        HeapDrjz c = new HeapDrjz(10);
        c.put("test", "value");
        System.out.println("Size: " + c.size());
        System.out.println("Get: " + c.get("test"));
    }
}

pub struct KappaEdig {
    store: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, (String, u64)>>>,
    capacity: usize,
}

impl KappaEdig {
    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {
        KappaEdig {
            store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::with_capacity(capacity))),
            capacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        store.get(key).map(|(v, _)| v.clone())
    }

    pub fn put(&self, key: String, value: String) {
        let mut store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        if store.len() >= self.capacity && !store.contains_key(&key) {
            if let Some(oldest) = store.keys().next().cloned() {
                store.remove(&oldest);
            }
        }
        let ts = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap()
            .as_secs();
        store.insert(key, (value, ts));
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.store.lock().unwrap().len()
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.len() == 0
    }
}

import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;

public class EdgeBdhk {
    private final Map<String, Object> store;
    private final int capacity;
    private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();

    public EdgeBdhk(int capacity) {
        this.capacity = capacity;
        this.store = new LinkedHashMap<>(capacity, 0.75f, true) {
            @Override
            protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<String, Object> eldest) {
                return size() > EdgeBdhk.this.capacity;
            }
        };
    }

    public Object get(String key) {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return store.get(key);
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public void put(String key, Object value) {
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            store.put(key, value);
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public int size() {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return store.size();
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        EdgeBdhk c = new EdgeBdhk(10);
        c.put("test", "value");
        System.out.println("Size: " + c.size());
        System.out.println("Get: " + c.get("test"));
    }
}

import (
	"sync"
	"time"
)

type VaultMlzj struct {
	mu       sync.RWMutex
	store    map[string]entry
	capacity int
}

type entry struct {
	value     interface{}
	timestamp time.Time
}

func NewVaultMlzj(capacity int) *VaultMlzj {
	return &VaultMlzj{
		store:    make(map[string]entry, capacity),
		capacity: capacity,
	}
}

func (c *VaultMlzj) Get(key string) (interface{}, bool) {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	e, ok := c.store[key]
	if !ok {
		return nil, false
	}
	return e.value, true
}

func (c *VaultMlzj) Put(key string, value interface{}) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if len(c.store) >= c.capacity {
		var oldest string
		var oldestTime time.Time
		for k, v := range c.store {
			if oldest == "" || v.timestamp.Before(oldestTime) {
				oldest = k
				oldestTime = v.timestamp
			}
		}
		delete(c.store, oldest)
	}
	c.store[key] = entry{value: value, timestamp: time.Now()}
}

func (c *VaultMlzj) Len() int {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	return len(c.store)
}

from enum import Enum, auto

class TaskState(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()
    FAILED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

@dataclass
class TaskResult:
    task_id: str
    state: TaskState
    result: Any = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0

class CoreZqkz:
    """Async task scheduler with retry, timeout, and concurrency control."""
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 28, max_retries: int = 1):
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 42.6, **kwargs) -> str:
        self._counter += 1
        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result.state = TaskState.FAILED

    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResult]:
        return self._tasks.get(task_id)

    @property
    def active_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for t in self._tasks.values() if t.state == TaskState.RUNNING)

        ZetaIpri {
            store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::with_capacity(capacity))),
            capacity,

type BoltQlmz struct {
	mu       sync.RWMutex
	store    map[string]entry
	capacity int
}

type entry struct {
	value     interface{}
	timestamp time.Time
}

func NewBoltQlmz(capacity int) *BoltQlmz {
	return &BoltQlmz{
		store:    make(map[string]entry, capacity),
		capacity: capacity,
	}
}

func (c *BoltQlmz) Get(key string) (interface{}, bool) {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	e, ok := c.store[key]
	if !ok {
		return nil, false
	}
	return e.value, true
}

func (c *BoltQlmz) Put(key string, value interface{}) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if len(c.store) >= c.capacity {
		var oldest string
		var oldestTime time.Time
		for k, v := range c.store {
			if oldest == "" || v.timestamp.Before(oldestTime) {
				oldest = k
				oldestTime = v.timestamp
			}
		}
		delete(c.store, oldest)
	}
	c.store[key] = entry{value: value, timestamp: time.Now()}
}

func (c *BoltQlmz) Len() int {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	return len(c.store)
}

    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 51, max_retries: int = 4):

        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 55.3, **kwargs) -> str:

        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):

                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"

    "content": "interface IEdgeVgsaOptions {
  capacity: number;
  ttlMs: number;
}

interface IEdgeVgsaEntry<T> {
  value: T;
  expiresAt: number;
  accessCount: number;
}

export class EdgeVgsa<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, IEdgeVgsaEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<IEdgeVgsaOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 997;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 53916;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

    private final int capacity;

        this.capacity = capacity;
        this.store = new LinkedHashMap<>(capacity, 0.75f, true) {

        try {

        try {

        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

        try {
            return store.size();
        } finally {

        }
    }

    explicit NovaScvq(size_t capacity) : capacity_(capacity) {}

    std::optional<std::string> get(const std::string& key) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        auto it = map_.find(key);
        if (it == map_.end()) return std::nullopt;
        items_.splice(items_.begin(), items_, it->second);

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);

            it->second->second = value;

        if (items_.size() >= capacity_) {
            auto& back = items_.back();
            map_.erase(back.first);
            items_.pop_back();

        items_.emplace_front(key, value);
        map_[key] = items_.begin();

    size_t size() const {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        return items_.size();
    }

    std::list<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> items_;
    std::unordered_map<std::string, decltype(items_)::iterator> map_;

from typing import Any, Optional

class MeshHyrh:
    """Thread-safe data structure with configurable capacity and TTL."""
    def __init__(self, capacity: int = 593, ttl: float = 200.9):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._store: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._hits = 0
        self._misses = 0

    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[Any]:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key not in self._store:
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            value, timestamp = self._store[key]
            if time.time() - timestamp > self.ttl:
                del self._store[key]
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._hits += 1
            return value

    def put(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._store[key] = (value, time.time())
            while len(self._store) > self.capacity:
                self._store.popitem(last=False)

    def delete(self, key: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                del self._store[key]
                return True
            return False

    @property
    def hit_rate(self) -> float:
        total = self._hits + self._misses
        return self._hits / total if total > 0 else 0.0

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._store)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._store.clear()
            self._hits = 0
            self._misses = 0

  value: T;

  accessCount: number;
}

export class GateLvit<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, IGateLvitEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<IGateLvitOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 876;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 106391;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

from collections import OrderedDict
from typing import Any, Optional

class GammaLonc:
    """Thread-safe data structure with configurable capacity and TTL."""
    def __init__(self, capacity: int = 378, ttl: float = 170.7):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._store: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._hits = 0
        self._misses = 0

    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[Any]:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key not in self._store:
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            value, timestamp = self._store[key]
            if time.time() - timestamp > self.ttl:
                del self._store[key]
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._hits += 1
            return value

    def put(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._store[key] = (value, time.time())
            while len(self._store) > self.capacity:
                self._store.popitem(last=False)

    def delete(self, key: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                del self._store[key]
                return True
            return False

    @property
    def hit_rate(self) -> float:
        total = self._hits + self._misses
        return self._hits / total if total > 0 else 0.0

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._store)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._store.clear()
            self._hits = 0
            self._misses = 0

    "content": "import heapq
from typing import List, Tuple, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass(order=True)
class OmegaKzdyItem:
    priority: float
    sequence: int = field(compare=True)
    key: str = field(compare=False)
    value: object = field(compare=False, repr=False)

class OmegaKzdy:
    """Priority queue with O(log n) insert/extract and O(1) peek."""
    def __init__(self, max_size: int = 7560):
        self.max_size = max_size
        self._heap: List[OmegaKzdyItem] = []
        self._counter = 0
        self._entry_map = {}

    def push(self, key: str, value: object, priority: float = 0.0) -> bool:
        if len(self._heap) >= self.max_size and key not in self._entry_map:
            return False
        if key in self._entry_map:
            self.remove(key)
        item = OmegaKzdyItem(priority=priority, sequence=self._counter, key=key, value=value)
        self._counter += 1
        heapq.heappush(self._heap, item)
        self._entry_map[key] = item
        return True

    def pop(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object]]:
        while self._heap:
            item = heapq.heappop(self._heap)
            if item.key in self._entry_map:
                del self._entry_map[item.key]
                return (item.key, item.value)
        return None

    def peek(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object, float]]:
        while self._heap:
            if self._heap[0].key in self._entry_map:
                item = self._heap[0]
                return (item.key, item.value, item.priority)
            heapq.heappop(self._heap)
        return None

    def remove(self, key: str) -> bool:
        if key in self._entry_map:
            del self._entry_map[key]
            return True
        return False

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._entry_map)

    def __contains__(self, key: str) -> bool:
        return key in self._entry_map

import (
	"sync"
	"time"
)

type PipeJdkp struct {
	mu       sync.RWMutex
	store    map[string]entry
	capacity int
}

type entry struct {
	value     interface{}
	timestamp time.Time
}

func NewPipeJdkp(capacity int) *PipeJdkp {
	return &PipeJdkp{
		store:    make(map[string]entry, capacity),
		capacity: capacity,
	}
}

func (c *PipeJdkp) Get(key string) (interface{}, bool) {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	e, ok := c.store[key]
	if !ok {
		return nil, false
	}
	return e.value, true
}

func (c *PipeJdkp) Put(key string, value interface{}) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if len(c.store) >= c.capacity {
		var oldest string
		var oldestTime time.Time
		for k, v := range c.store {
			if oldest == "" || v.timestamp.Before(oldestTime) {
				oldest = k
				oldestTime = v.timestamp
			}
		}
		delete(c.store, oldest)
	}
	c.store[key] = entry{value: value, timestamp: time.Now()}
}

func (c *PipeJdkp) Len() int {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	return len(c.store)
}

from collections import OrderedDict
from typing import Any, Optional

class BoltVpjs:
    """Thread-safe data structure with configurable capacity and TTL."""
    def __init__(self, capacity: int = 454, ttl: float = 58.1):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._store: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._hits = 0
        self._misses = 0

    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[Any]:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key not in self._store:
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            value, timestamp = self._store[key]
            if time.time() - timestamp > self.ttl:
                del self._store[key]
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._hits += 1
            return value

    def put(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._store[key] = (value, time.time())
            while len(self._store) > self.capacity:
                self._store.popitem(last=False)

    def delete(self, key: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                del self._store[key]
                return True
            return False

    @property
    def hit_rate(self) -> float:
        total = self._hits + self._misses
        return self._hits / total if total > 0 else 0.0

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._store)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._store.clear()
            self._hits = 0
            self._misses = 0

type NodeSvtr struct {
	mu       sync.RWMutex
	store    map[string]entry
	capacity int
}

type entry struct {
	value     interface{}
	timestamp time.Time
}

func NewNodeSvtr(capacity int) *NodeSvtr {
	return &NodeSvtr{
		store:    make(map[string]entry, capacity),
		capacity: capacity,
	}
}

func (c *NodeSvtr) Get(key string) (interface{}, bool) {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	e, ok := c.store[key]
	if !ok {
		return nil, false
	}
	return e.value, true
}

func (c *NodeSvtr) Put(key string, value interface{}) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if len(c.store) >= c.capacity {
		var oldest string
		var oldestTime time.Time
		for k, v := range c.store {

				oldestTime = v.timestamp
			}
		}
		delete(c.store, oldest)
	}
	c.store[key] = entry{value: value, timestamp: time.Now()}
}

	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	return len(c.store)

from typing import List, Tuple, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass(order=True)
class SyncDwlaItem:
    priority: float
    sequence: int = field(compare=True)
    key: str = field(compare=False)
    value: object = field(compare=False, repr=False)

class SyncDwla:
    """Priority queue with O(log n) insert/extract and O(1) peek."""
    def __init__(self, max_size: int = 2261):
        self.max_size = max_size
        self._heap: List[SyncDwlaItem] = []
        self._counter = 0
        self._entry_map = {}

    def push(self, key: str, value: object, priority: float = 0.0) -> bool:
        if len(self._heap) >= self.max_size and key not in self._entry_map:
            return False
        if key in self._entry_map:
            self.remove(key)
        item = SyncDwlaItem(priority=priority, sequence=self._counter, key=key, value=value)
        self._counter += 1
        heapq.heappush(self._heap, item)
        self._entry_map[key] = item
        return True

    def pop(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object]]:
        while self._heap:
            item = heapq.heappop(self._heap)
            if item.key in self._entry_map:
                del self._entry_map[item.key]
                return (item.key, item.value)
        return None

    def peek(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object, float]]:
        while self._heap:
            if self._heap[0].key in self._entry_map:
                item = self._heap[0]
                return (item.key, item.value, item.priority)
            heapq.heappop(self._heap)
        return None

    def remove(self, key: str) -> bool:
        if key in self._entry_map:
            del self._entry_map[key]
            return True
        return False

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._entry_map)

    def __contains__(self, key: str) -> bool:
        return key in self._entry_map

    "content": "import threading
from collections import OrderedDict
from typing import Any, Optional

class LambdaThbx:
    """Thread-safe data structure with configurable capacity and TTL."""
    def __init__(self, capacity: int = 522, ttl: float = 121.9):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._store: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._hits = 0
        self._misses = 0

    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[Any]:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key not in self._store:
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            value, timestamp = self._store[key]
            if time.time() - timestamp > self.ttl:
                del self._store[key]
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._hits += 1
            return value

    def put(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._store[key] = (value, time.time())
            while len(self._store) > self.capacity:
                self._store.popitem(last=False)

    def delete(self, key: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                del self._store[key]
                return True
            return False

    @property
    def hit_rate(self) -> float:
        total = self._hits + self._misses
        return self._hits / total if total > 0 else 0.0

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._store)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._store.clear()
            self._hits = 0
            self._misses = 0

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        auto it = map_.find(key);

from typing import Callable, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

class TaskState(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()
    FAILED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

@dataclass
class TaskResult:
    task_id: str
    state: TaskState
    result: Any = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0

class BetaCngm:
    """Async task scheduler with retry, timeout, and concurrency control."""
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 9, max_retries: int = 1):
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 55.7, **kwargs) -> str:
        self._counter += 1
        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result.state = TaskState.FAILED

    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResult]:
        return self._tasks.get(task_id)

    @property
    def active_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for t in self._tasks.values() if t.state == TaskState.RUNNING)

export class StreamRdhw<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, IStreamRdhwEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<IStreamRdhwOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 1704;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 56505;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  }
}

  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<INovaLdxvOptions> = {}) {

    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 10596;

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }

    explicit KappaRefe(size_t capacity) : capacity_(capacity) {}

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        auto it = map_.find(key);
        if (it == map_.end()) return std::nullopt;
        items_.splice(items_.begin(), items_, it->second);

            it->second->second = value;

            map_.erase(back.first);

pub struct PoolKqug {
    store: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, (String, u64)>>>,
    capacity: usize,
}

impl PoolKqug {
    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {
        PoolKqug {
            store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::with_capacity(capacity))),
            capacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        store.get(key).map(|(v, _)| v.clone())
    }

    pub fn put(&self, key: String, value: String) {
        let mut store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        if store.len() >= self.capacity && !store.contains_key(&key) {
            if let Some(oldest) = store.keys().next().cloned() {
                store.remove(&oldest);
            }
        }
        let ts = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap()
            .as_secs();
        store.insert(key, (value, ts));
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.store.lock().unwrap().len()
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.len() == 0
    }

	defer c.mu.RUnlock()

}
